text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said Friday it lowered its intermediate-term rating on Firstar Corp to market performer from outperform, after the Milwaukee-based bank holding company said fourth quarter earnings would fall below analysts' expectations.
-- The long-term rating remains outperform, analyst Thomas Maier said in a research note.

-- "We have adjusted our earnings estimates for the fourth quarter and for next year to reflect slower loan, therefore revenue, growth and higher operating expenses through the first half of next year," Maier wrote.
-- Fourth quarter earnings estimate was lowered to $0.95 a share, where Firstar said Thursday it estimated its earnings, from $1.05, Maier said.
-- Full 1997 estimate was lowered to $4.50 a share from $4.65 a share, EVEREN said.
-- Long term price objective is $60, down from $66, Maier said. Firstar shares were down 1-1/8 at 49-7/8 Friday.
